name: usage-bar
description: Desktop app only. A configurable status row at the bottom of the band above the prompt: 5-hour and weekly plan limits, prompt-cache time left, and optional context, cost and other limits; a second row shows output speed, time to first token, cache hit rate and failed requests. Colors follow the percentage (green, Claude orange, red).

show_cache.title: Prompt cache
show_cache.description: Show how long the main conversation's prompt cache stays warm.

show_other_limits.title: Other limits
show_other_limits.description: Show any other limit window the API reports (such as a gateway spend limit), once it passes the threshold below.

show_context.title: Context
show_context.description: Show how full the context window is. The desktop app already shows this, so it is off by default.

show_cost.title: Session cost
show_cost.description: Show the session's estimated API cost. On a subscription this is an estimate, not what you pay.

show_reset.title: Reset countdown
show_reset.description: Show the time left until each limit resets.

show_speed.title: Output speed
show_speed.description: Second row: this session's main-thread output tokens per second, summed like DeepSeek Harness does: total output tokens (hidden thinking included) over total time from each response's start to its end.

show_first_token.title: Time to first token
show_first_token.description: Second row: average seconds this session from sending a main-thread request until its response starts, retries the engine makes included.

show_cache_hit.title: Cache hit rate
show_cache_hit.description: Second row: share of the latest main-thread request's input read from the prompt cache. Marked 'Write' when it mostly wrote the cache, which is normal for a first or post-expiry request.

show_failures.title: Failed requests
show_failures.description: Second row: requests this session, subagents included, that got no response. Requests you interrupt do not count.

conditional_threshold.title: Other limits threshold
conditional_threshold.description: Percent at which other limits start to show.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto gives usage and performance a row each and wraps a row that is too narrow; one-line puts everything on one row; two-lines splits the items into two rows when only one group is shown.

bar.title: Bar style
bar.description: dither: pixel bars; solid: filled bars; none: numbers only.

color.title: Color mode
color.description: by-percent: blend through the color stops; threshold: change color at 80% and 95%; mono: one color.

color_stops.title: Color stops
color_stops.description: percent:#hex pairs, comma separated. Colors blend by hue between stops.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Show an icon before each item.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long the cache countdown runs after the last main-thread turn. Match it to your prompt-cache TTL.

notify_at.title: Notify at
notify_at.description: Percents of the 5-hour or weekly limit that raise a notification, comma separated. Empty turns it off.
